        pid = n.get('parent')
        if pid is not None:
            node_map[pid]['children'].append(n['id'])
    
    # Determine processing order: sort by depth descending, then by id ascending
    sorted_nodes = sorted(nodes, key=lambda n: (-n['depth'], n['id']))
    
    retained = set(node_map.keys())  # initially all
    removed = []  # list in order
    
    for n in sorted_nodes:
        nid = n['id']
        if nid not in retained:
            continue  # already removed (should not happen because processed in order)
